title: InsideEVs - Genesis EVs get Tesla Supercharger access in the US (2025)
notes: Genesis GV60, Electrified GV70 and Electrified G80 (US, CCS1) get a free NACS-to-CCS adapter and about 20,000 Superchargers; owners who bought or leased by 2025-01-31, adapters shipped from the week of 2025-04-07. From the 2026 model year every US Genesis EV has a native NACS port.
